info.title: 3D Bruckner Portfolio API
info.description:
3dbruckner.de's prints: their fields, photos, categories and order, and the export the site build reads. Every operation but the export and a photo's bytes mirrors an MCP tool of /mcp, named in its description.

Every error is JSON, `{"error": "...", "code": "..."}`. Besides the responses listed per operation, an unknown path answers 404, a method an operation doesn't have 405 with `Allow`, and a failure on the server's side 500 (`internal`) without details.

tags.description: Drafts and published prints, their fields and publishing.

tags.name: Order

tags.name: Photos

tags.name: Categories
tags.description: The categories prints are filed under.

tags.name: Site

get.summary: List prints: drafts newest first, then the published ones in the site's order
get.description: The REST counterpart of the MCP tool `list_prints`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only drafts or only published prints.

schema.description: Only drafts or only published prints.

title.description: The print's title as the site shows it, e.g. 'Beyblade – Dragoon'.

shortTitle.description: A shorter title for cards and lists; without it the site uses the title up to ' – '.

description.description: What the print is, in German, as the site shows it under the photos.

price.description: The price in whole euros; none: the site shows no price.

selfDesigned.description: Whether Marcel designed the model himself (rather than printing someone else's).

weightGrams.description: The filament used, in grams, from the slicer.

printTimeMinutes.description: The print time in minutes, from the slicer.

colors.description: How many filament colours the print uses.

categoryIds.description: The ids of the print's categories, in order: the first is its main one (list them with the categories' list).

sources.description: Where the model comes from, e.g. [{label: 'MakerWorld', url: 'https://makerworld.com/…'}].

slug.description: The print's address on the site (/portfolio/<slug>). Can change only until the print is first published.

showcase.description: Pinned above the rest of the portfolio (and on the start page).

original.description: The original's size as shown (its orientation applied), the space a crop is chosen in; null for a photo stored before originals were kept.

crop.description: The cutout's rectangle in the original as shown; null: the whole photo.

firstPublishedAt.description: When it was first published; its slug is fixed from then on.

url.description: The print's page in the web app.

400.description: The request can't be read, or a value in it is not acceptable (`invalid_input`)

401.description: No valid API token or OAuth access token for this API (`unauthorized`)

get.summary: Every published print in the site's order, with its photos and the categories: what the site build reads

categories.description: The categories the published prints use, by name.

slug.description: The print's address on the site (/portfolio/<slug>). Can change only until the print is first published.

title.description: The print's title as the site shows it, e.g. 'Beyblade – Dragoon'.

shortTitle.description: A shorter title for cards and lists; without it the site uses the title up to ' – '.

description.description: What the print is, in German, as the site shows it under the photos.

price.description: The price in whole euros; none: the site shows no price.

selfDesigned.description: Whether Marcel designed the model himself (rather than printing someone else's).

sources.description: Where the model comes from, e.g. [{label: 'MakerWorld', url: 'https://makerworld.com/…'}].

weightGrams.description: The filament used, in grams, from the slicer.

printTimeMinutes.description: The print time in minutes, from the slicer.

colors.description: How many filament colours the print uses.

showcase.description: Pinned above the rest of the portfolio and shown on the start page.

sha256.description: The cutout's SHA-256, hex: a new crop changes it.

url.description: Where its JPEG is downloaded (GET, with the same token).

photos.description: The print's photos, in their order.

prints.description: Every published print in the site's order: the showcases first, in theirs, then the rest.

401.description: No valid API token or OAuth access token for this API (`unauthorized`)

get.summary: Whether a site build is pending (a minute after the last change the site shows), how the last dispatch went, and the latest build run
get.description: The REST counterpart of the MCP tool `site_build_status`.

pending.description: Changes the site shows wait for a build; it is dispatched once nothing changed for a minute.

lastDispatch.description: When the site build was last dispatched.

lastError.description: Why the last dispatch failed; it is tried again after 1, 2, 4 … minutes, at most 30.

run.description: The latest dispatched run of the site's workflow; absent when there is none or GitHub didn't answer.

post.summary: Make an API token for the caller; the token is in this answer once and never again. Not with an API token (403)
post.description: The REST counterpart of the MCP tool `create_api_token`.

name.description: What it is for, e.g. 'site build'.

scope.description: `read` may only GET (the site build's); `read+write` may change things.

expiresInDays.description: Its lifetime in days; null: it never expires (chosen on purpose).

start.description: The token's first characters, to recognise it by.

token.description: The token itself, shown this once.
